resources.string: Battery optimisation can freeze the runtime in the background. Allow the app to ignore it.
Starting is taking unusually long. A self-test is running now; wait for it to finish (a minute or two), then press Debug > Copy diagnostics and send it.
Self-test running. Wait for it to finish before you copy the diagnostics, so the dump contains its result.
Something failed. Once no self-test is running, press Debug > Copy diagnostics and send it.
How should the agent reach Gemini?
User credentials JSON (Vertex AI, gcloud login)
Uses generativelanguage.googleapis.com. Model ids are plain, for example gemini-4-hydrogen.
Uses aiplatform.googleapis.com with an express-mode key. Adding a project routes to its global location, which Gemini 4 Argon needs.
Import the key file of a service account that has the Vertex AI User role.
Import the application_default_credentials.json that gcloud auth application-default login creates (type authorized_user). It carries no project, so enter the project id below.

Default leaves it to Hermes (medium). Lower levels answer faster and cost less.
Unknown thinking effort. Pick one of the chips.
User credentials contain no project: enter the project id.
Project id may only contain lowercase letters, digits, - and _.
Region may only contain lowercase letters, digits and -.
The runtime is up, but the saved setup is incomplete (credentials or fields). Finish Setup and press Save and apply.
No credentials imported for this mode yet.
Saved. Takes effect the next time the runtime starts.
Saved. Restarting the runtime to apply.
Paste the whole file. The text is hidden, checked, stored privately and then cleared from this field.
